dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward a pointed posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Continuous and smooth lateral margins without localized asymmetrical bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface, consistent with a sub-adult skin tone.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse lighter-grey patches distributed irregularly across the central and posterior dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between localized pigmented variations and the primary grey baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One high-contrast dark circular point (blowhole) at the anterior; faint, low-contrast linear striations visible on the posterior dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Subtle longitudinal linear marks, likely superficial epidermal scratches, are visible on the posterior third of the dorsal region.
